svg.title: kit's entities
svg.desc: Overview of kit's entities: ten domains, the entities each holds, and the provenance chain that runs from an issue to where its code runs.
svg.text: Ten domains hold what kit names. Everything is a subject, named by a reference, and labels, conversations, events, and evidence are all about a subject. Each domain has a diagram of
what git and the forge hold
what is built, released, and run
what shows the work can be trusted
what runs on a desk and in CI
where people talk about the work
PROVENANCE: THE CHAIN THAT RUNS THROUGH THE DOMAINS, FROM AN ISSUE TO WHERE ITS CODE RUNS
Each pill takes its domain's color. Release is two entities: a version published from a tag (Delivery), and a kit version, one tarball (kit's content).
Code stands over git's own entities, which the Git, Git repository, and Git configuration domains model natively, each on a page of its own.
